mechanism: supervisor waits for the worker's ready pulse with MsgReceivePulse() and no timeout. If the worker exits or stalls before sending the pulse, supervisor stays RECEIVE-blocked on its channel forever. Fix: bound the wait (for example TimerTimeout(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, _NTO_TIMEOUT_RECEIVE, ...) re-armed with the remaining time), and on ETIMEDOUT print the message, kill and reap the worker and exit 3.
